name: Albatroz + Soda Cáustica
description: Kick off the weekend with a double bill of live rock at one of Porto's most beloved alternative cultural venues, located on the top floor of a car park.
longDescription:
Maus Hábitos hosts a double concert featuring Albatroz and Soda Cáustica on Thursday, July 30, 2026. Albatroz is a Porto-based rock band known for their energetic performances and blend of garage rock and psychedelic influences. Soda Cáustica, also from Porto, brings a raw, punk-infused sound to the stage, often incorporating elements of post-punk and alternative rock. Both bands are active within Porto's independent music scene.

Attendees can expect an evening of live rock music in the distinctive setting of Maus Hábitos. The venue, situated on the top floor of a multi-storey car park, offers an alternative atmosphere with views over the city. The event is scheduled to begin at 10 PM, providing an opportunity to experience two local bands in a single night. The audience typically consists of individuals interested in independent and alternative music.

Tickets for the event are available for purchase, with pricing details to be confirmed on the venue's website. Maus Hábitos is located near the Trindade metro station, approximately a 5-minute walk away, and is also accessible via several bus routes. The venue is situated in the city centre.
